1.  This petition has been filed for quashing of FIR No.376/2021 PS Sunlight Colony under Section 3(1)(r)(s) of the SC/ST Act on grounds of settlement between the parties dated 26th July, 2022 arrived at with the facilitation of the Mediation Centre, Saket Cousts, New Delhi.

As per the learned counsel for the petitioner, the issue arises out of a matrimonial discord between the petitioner No.1/wife and respondent No.2/husband where both parties registered FIRs against each other.

2. While this FIR was registered by the respondent No.2/husband against the wife/petitioner No.1,
the petitioner No.1 registered an FIR No.612/2021 PS Badarpur under Section 498A IPC against the respondent No.2.
Petitioner Nos.1-5 are all persent before this Court and duly identified by the

However, respondent No.2 is not present.
Attempts to contact respondent No.2 have not been successful even through the IO.
3. Court Notice be, therefore, issued to respondent No.2 to be present in Court on the next of hearing to be served through the IO.
4. The petitioner Nos.2-5 are family members of petitioner No.1 and are exempted from appearing in Court on the next date of hearing on the oral request of the learned counsel for the petitioner.

5. The petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 have now got divorced by decree dated 24th November,
2022.
One female child was born out of their wedlock.
